titles.romaji: Kino no Tabi: the Beautiful World - Tou no Kuni: Free Lance
titles.native: キノの旅 the Beautiful World 塔の国 -Free Lance-

description: Kino sets off to yet another country: Tower Country. Here all citizens work on the construction of a massive tower, without knowing what purpose it serves. The rather odd encounter with a young boy adds yet another twist to the story.
